lines: Ledgers on that shelf go back to 1802 and my family has written every line of them.
The last four years are thin because everything that used to come up the road now flies.
I am not bitter. My daughter loads airships. I am extremely proud and slightly bitter.
There was a year, when I was small, when the wind stopped for a whole day. Just stopped.
Everyone came outside. Nobody could work. The town was so quiet people cried.
This is not that. This is the opposite of that and I would rather have that.
Eighty-one years on this cliff and I have crossed to the other side four times.
It is very nice over there. Everything is new and nothing is bolted to anything.
Four times in eighty-one years. It is right there. I could throw a shoe at it.
